card.line: Straight Street was a long, wide main road in Damascus where the Lord sent Ananias to find Saul, the man He chose to carry His name.

moments.title: The Lord sends Ananias
moments.text: In a vision the Lord tells Ananias to go to the house of Judas on Straight Street and ask for Saul of Tarsus, who is praying. Ananias speaks of the harm Saul has done, but the Lord says Saul is His chosen instrument.
